con:part.con:content: <wsdl:definitions name="UserService" targetNamespace="http://example.com/userservice" xmlns:tns="http://example.com/userservice" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/soap/" xmlns:wsdl="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/"> <!--======================= TYPES =======================--> <wsdl:types> <xsd:schema targetNamespace="http://example.com/userservice" elementFormDefault="unqualified"> <!--Reusable User type: includes id, name, role, and lastSeen--> <xsd:complexType name="User"> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="id" type="xsd:int"/> <xsd:element name="name" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="role" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="lastSeen" type="xsd:dateTime" minOccurs="0"/> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> <!--===== Operation 1: CreateUser =====--> <xsd:element name="CreateUserRequest"> <xsd:complexType> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="name" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="role" type="xsd:string"/> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="CreateUserResponse"> <xsd:complexType> <xsd:sequence> <!--Returns only the id of the newly created user--> <xsd:element name="id" type="xsd:int"/> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> </xsd:element> <!--===== Operation 2: GetUsers =====--> <xsd:element name="GetUsersRequest"> <xsd:complexType> <xsd:sequence> <!--All filters are optional; any combination can be supplied--> <xsd:element name="id" type="xsd:int" minOccurs="0"/> <xsd:element name="name" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0"/> <xsd:element name="role" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0"/> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="GetUsersResponse"> <xsd:complexType> <xsd:sequence> <!--Zero or more matching users, each with all its fields--> <xsd:element name="user" type="tns:User" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> </xsd:element> <!--===== Operation 3: SetLastSeen (one-way, no response) =====--> <xsd:element name="SetLastSeenRequest"> <xsd:complexType> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="id" type="xsd:int"/> <xsd:element name="lastSeen" type="xsd:dateTime"/> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> </xsd:element> </xsd:schema> </wsdl:types> <!--======================= MESSAGES =======================--> <wsdl:message name="CreateUserRequestMessage"> <wsdl:part name="parameters" element="tns:CreateUserRequest"/> </wsdl:message> <wsdl:message name="CreateUserResponseMessage"> <wsdl:part name="parameters" element="tns:CreateUserResponse"/> </wsdl:message> <wsdl:message name="GetUsersRequestMessage"> <wsdl:part name="parameters" element="tns:GetUsersRequest"/> </wsdl:message> <wsdl:message name="GetUsersResponseMessage"> <wsdl:part name="parameters" element="tns:GetUsersResponse"/> </wsdl:message> <!--No response message for SetLastSeen: it is one-way--> <wsdl:message name="SetLastSeenRequestMessage"> <wsdl:part name="parameters" element="tns:SetLastSeenRequest"/> </wsdl:message> <!--======================= PORT TYPE =======================--> <wsdl:portType name="UserServicePortType"> <wsdl:operation name="CreateUser"> <wsdl:input message="tns:CreateUserRequestMessage"/> <wsdl:output message="tns:CreateUserResponseMessage"/> </wsdl:operation> <wsdl:operation name="GetUsers"> <wsdl:input message="tns:GetUsersRequestMessage"/> <wsdl:output message="tns:GetUsersResponseMessage"/> </wsdl:operation> <!--One-way operation: only an input, no output--> <wsdl:operation name="SetLastSeen"> <wsdl:input message="tns:SetLastSeenRequestMessage"/> </wsdl:operation> </wsdl:portType> <!--======================= BINDING =======================--> <wsdl:binding name="UserServiceBinding" type="tns:UserServicePortType"> <soap:binding style="document" transport="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/http"/> <wsdl:operation name="CreateUser"> <soap:operation soapAction="http://example.com/userservice/CreateUser"/> <wsdl:input> <soap:body use="literal"/> </wsdl:input> <wsdl:output> <soap:body use="literal"/> </wsdl:output> </wsdl:operation> <wsdl:operation name="GetUsers"> <soap:operation soapAction="http://example.com/userservice/GetUsers"/> <wsdl:input> <soap:body use="literal"/> </wsdl:input> <wsdl:output> <soap:body use="literal"/> </wsdl:output> </wsdl:operation> <!--One-way binding: input only, no output block, no fault--> <wsdl:operation name="SetLastSeen"> <soap:operation soapAction="http://example.com/userservice/SetLastSeen" style="document"/> <wsdl:input> <soap:body use="literal"/> </wsdl:input> </wsdl:operation> </wsdl:binding> <!--======================= SERVICE =======================--> <wsdl:service name="UserService"> <wsdl:port name="UserServicePort" binding="tns:UserServiceBinding"> <soap:address location="http://example.com/userservice"/> </wsdl:port> </wsdl:service> </wsdl:definitions>
